comment: Manual read at https://flagaudio.com/vcv/tap-dancer.html. The panel prints LP twice (input filter and feedback tap), HP twice (feedback tap and output) and DUCK twice (feedback duck and output duck mix); the maker's own param names separate them and the panel positions were used to map them. Param 17 Feedback Amp has no panel lettering, only the arrow drawn back into the delay line. Param 20 In Mix also has no lettering and no artwork in the SVG: it is drawn in code as a three-position switch, and the maker's own wording gives 'Mid' beside 'In Mix', with 'Left' and 'Right' already present as port names, which suggests the three positions are left, mid and right. That was not confirmed, so the line says only that it is a three-position input mix. The Tap Dancer widget has a context menu with six items whose text could not be recovered; no Menu lines were written.
